name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each.
benefit_description: ₹2,000 every 4 months directly to bank account. Covers all landholding farmer families.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest CSC center or PM-KISAN portal → Register with Aadhaar + land records → Verified by state → Amount transferred to bank

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers in case of crop failure due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefit_description: Premium: 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial/horticulture. Government pays remaining premium. Claims settled to bank account.
how_to_apply: Visit bank/CSC/PMFBY portal → Fill crop details → Pay subsidized premium → Get insurance coverage

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Provides farmers with affordable credit for agriculture, animal husbandry, and fisheries activities at subsidized interest rates.
benefit_amount: Up to ₹3 lakhs at 4% interest (with subvention)
benefit_description: 7% interest rate with 3% subvention (net 4%) for loans up to ₹3 lakhs if repaid on time. Also covers personal accident insurance of ₹50,000.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest bank branch → Fill KCC application form → Submit land documents → Bank processes and issues KCC

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise recommendations for nutrients and fertilizers to improve productivity.
benefit_description: Free soil testing every 2 years, crop-specific fertilizer recommendations, and guidance for soil improvement
how_to_apply: Register on Soil Health Card portal or visit nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra → Soil sample collected → Tested → Card issued with recommendations

name: PM Kisan MaanDhan Yojana (Pension Scheme)
description: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 years to receive ₹3,000/month pension after age 60.
benefit_description: Monthly contribution ₹55-200 (based on age). Government matches contribution equally. ₹3,000/month pension after 60.
how_to_apply: Visit CSC center → Register with Aadhaar → Select monthly contribution → Auto-debit from bank → Pension from age 60

name: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
description: Promotes sustainable agriculture through climate change adaptation, soil health management, and rainfed area development.
benefit_amount: Subsidies up to 50-90% on various components
benefit_description: Subsidies on micro-irrigation, organic farming, soil conservation, water harvesting. Up to 90% for SC/ST/small farmers.
how_to_apply: Apply through State Agriculture Department or DBT Agriculture portal → Submit land details → Approved → Get subsidy
